title: Readability: best-effort indexing pattern not clearly intentional
description: Lines 596-620 in session/lifecycle.rs implement best-effort search indexing (failures logged but POST succeeds), but the intent is not signaled clearly enough. A reader unfamiliar with the design might assume failed indexing is a bug. The doc comment says 'best-effort' but the inline pattern (log then continue) could be clearer about why we never fail the POST due to indexing failure.
